# CACAO component candidate

Public AMD FidelityFX-CACAO commit `0ddca95e6714727a252ead345591ca8f2598f261`.
The original AMD/Intel MIT notices, source and upstream instructions are
preserved byte-for-byte as Git blobs. `UPSTREAM.json` records every hash.
No game or firmware data is included.

This is an isolated component. It does not enable AO in the game or change
its rendering. The runtime still needs validated world depth/projection
selection, multisample handling, insertion before the HUD, capability fallback,
settings and measured gameplay comparisons.

Generate the shader pack with `tools/build_cacao_shaders.py`, passing explicit
DXC and SPIRV-Tools validator paths and a new output directory. The generator
builds and validates all 33 entry points in both 16-bit and 32-bit variants.
The 32-bit context must be used unless the device's 16-bit features are enabled.
The Vulkan backend requires its sampled/storage formats to be supported.

The generator leaves upstream files unchanged and makes these compatibility
adaptations in a separate generated source copy:

- Two variable mip0 Texture.Load offsets become integer coordinate additions.
  Current DXC rejects the original variable offset operands for SPIR-V.
- Fifteen storage images get explicit Vulkan format attributes matching the
  reference backend's allocations. Current DXC otherwise chooses incompatible
  32-bit defaults. The application output format for this pack is R8_UNORM.
- Embedded SPIR-V byte arrays have explicit four-byte alignment.

The initial verified compiler is Microsoft DXC v1.9.2609.5. HLSL2018 and
Vulkan1.1 targets are explicit. Output metadata records compiler identity,
commands, shader hashes and validation results. The generated bytecode matches
the separate initial component build for all66 variants.

`tests/test_cacao_vulkan.cpp` links the two real public C++ implementation
files and requires Vulkan. Add `inc/`, the generated output directory and
Vulkan headers to includes; define `FFX_CACAO_ENABLE_VULKAN`. Select CPU lavapipe
externally when running without a physical GPU slot. The fixture tests flat
and occluding depth, repeatability and resize; optional output is actual PGM
readback. Validation layers are used when available and their absence is
reported. Linux CPU execution passed112 checks. Windows linked; Android
implementation objects compiled. Physical GPU and live-game AO remain pending.

Controller wrote the fixture after managed Claude job-IywAvw timed out without
a usable artifact. No worker source was applied or recovered and no retry ran.

Sources: [AMD CACAO](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-CACAO),
[DXC SPIR-V attributes](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/blob/main/docs/SPIR-V.rst).
